fact: 1937年英属印度根据1935年印度政府法举行首次省议会选举，约10%—12%人口获得选举权；印度国民大会党（国大党）赢得约1585个省议席中的706席，在11省中的5省获绝对多数，并在7省组建省政府。

sources.title: Indian National Congress - INC Timeline 1935-1945（国大党官方）
sources.quote: In 1937, first elections were held for the provincial legislatures. About 10 to 12 % of the population had the right to vote. The Congress won an absolute majority in 5 out of 11 provinces and formed governments in 7 provinces.

sources.title: Election of 1937: GOI Act 1935, Provisions（Testbook）
sources.quote: The Indian National Congress won 706 out of about 1,585 provincial seats. It went on to form ministries in seven provinces including Madras, Bombay, United Provinces, Bihar, Orissa, Central Provinces, and NWFP.

fact: 1937年7月，国大党在中央省、奥里萨、比哈尔、联合省、马德拉斯与孟买正式组建省政府，随后又在阿萨姆与西北边省组阁，开始'民族运动与议会治理结合'的试验。

sources.title: The Congress And Parliamentarism（CPI(ML) Liberation）
sources.quote: Congress ministries were formed in Central Provinces, Orissa, Bihar, UP, Madras and Bombay in July 1937 and later in NEFA and Assam.

fact: 1937年，印度最大财团塔塔（Tatas）加入印度全国商会联合会（FICCI），此举与国大党省政府上台直接相关——塔塔主要利益集中在国大党执政的孟买、比哈尔与中央省，希望借助FICCI与国大党的特殊关系获得政策红利。

sources.title: Indian Business and the Congress Provincial Governments 1937-39（Claude Markovits, Ashoka University Institutional Repository）
sources.quote: In what amounted to a spectacular break with a ten-year-old policy, the Tatas, the biggest Indian business group joined the FICCI in 1937. Their move was directly related to the advent of the Congress ministries: the Tatas, who had the bulk of their interests in the Congress-ruled provinces of Bombay, Bihar and the Central Provinces, wanted to benefit from the privileged relationship existing between the FICCI and the Congress.

fact: 到二战前夕，印度产布料在国内市场的份额已超过80%，实现进口替代；这一成功被认为主要得益于1925年后调整的保护关税，使印度企业（以孟买棉纺织厂为代表）得以占据国内市场。

sources.title: Human Beings Are Too Cheap in India: Wages and Work Organization as Business Strategies in Bombay's Late Colonial Textile Industry（International Review of Social History, Cambridge University Press）
sources.quote: the Indian share of the domestic fabric market had increased to over eighty per cent by the eve of World War II, indicating successful import substitution. Traditional explanations for this accomplishment emphasize the role of protective tariffs (and modifications to these tariffs after 1925).

fact: 国大党1937年选举宣言承诺调解劳资纠纷、保障工人组织工会与罢工权利；国大党省政府上台后工会化加速，印度工会会员数在1937年后增长约50%。

sources.title: The Rise of India's Labor Movement: From Colonial Oppression to Workers' Rights（HistoryGuruji）
sources.quote: In its election manifesto, Congress declared it would take steps to settle workers' disputes and implement effective measures to secure their rights to form unions and strike.……Trade union membership increased 50 percent in [the period after the Congress governments took office].

fact: 1938年11月，孟买国大党省政府匆匆通过《孟买劳资争议法》，规定强制仲裁、使几乎所有罢工非法，将非法罢工的监禁处罚从三个月提高到六个月——与国大党选举承诺的工人权利形成反转。

sources.title: 75 Years of India's Independence: Workers In India's Freedom Struggle（AICCTU）
sources.quote: And in Bombay, the Congress ministry rushed through the Bombay Trades Disputes Act in November 1938 which was far worse than the earlier 1929 version of the Act. It imposed compulsory arbitration thereby making virtually all strikes illegal and raised the prison-penalty for illegal strikes from three months to six months.

fact: 1937年孟加拉黄麻纺织厂爆发大罢工，由工资争议与恶化的劳动条件引发，涉及多家工厂协调行动，是殖民印度最广泛的工业行动之一；这反映1937年印度产业工人工资在生活成本压力下的紧张状态。

sources.title: India - International Trade Union History and Memory Network（Simon Fraser University）
sources.quote: The 1937 general strike in Bengal's jute mills represented one of the most extensive industrial actions in colonial India. Triggered by wage disputes and worsening labour conditions, the strike involved coordinated action across multiple mills.
